retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, minimalist layout featuring a central, textured hand-written script against a dark, weathered background with clean sans-serif secondary text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, dark composition dominated by a central, expressive script title that appears to be written in chalk or spray paint, characterized by a grainy, stippled halo effect. The background is a deep, textured black resembling worn paper or a chalkboard, with secondary clean typography positioned at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Central expressive script vs. peripheral geometric sans-serif
Bright white textural elements vs. deep matte black background
Organic, irregular letterforms vs. rigid, structured layout
coreInvariants: Grainy, stippled texture on the primary script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary title is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured script title acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left secondary text, drops to the central script, and then explores the surrounding dark texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounds the central text, creating a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Matte black background with subtle grey paper grain.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white to bright white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None; the design relies on textural variation rather than color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the dark ground and light figures.

letterConstructionRules: Primary script uses a continuous, fluid stroke with varying thickness.
Secondary text uses uniform stroke weight and wide tracking.
Edges of the script are softened by a spray-like or chalky stipple effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 't' in the script is integrated into the flow of the word with a long, horizontal crossbar.
The 'g' and 'h' have elongated, expressive descenders and ascenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, textured script and clean, geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The chalky texture of the script
The wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean uppercase secondary text.
The primary text requires a hand-drawn feel with specific textural artifacts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of a black, weathered paper or a worn chalkboard with subtle white dust and creases.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hand-written cursive script in the center with a white stippled/spray-paint texture. Add clean, light-weight uppercase sans-serif text at the top left with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the central script textured with a grainy halo?
Is the background a dark, distressed monochrome?
Is the secondary text clean, uppercase, and widely spaced?
Is the overall composition minimalist and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Amount of stippled grain around the letters
Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos

mustAchieve: Authentic chalk/spray texture on the script
Deep, rich black background with visible grain
avoid: Perfectly clean digital fonts for the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script is legible despite the texture.
Verify the top text is aligned to the left margin.
Check that the grain does not obscure the letterforms.
Confirm the monochrome palette is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a distressed dark paper background with a central, stippled hand-drawn script and a peripheral geometric sans-serif for a classic nocturnal aesthetic.
